visual.name: bfusionRiskRadarChart
visual.description: Interactive radar/spider chart for multi-dimensional risk assessment with insights sidebar, mini risk matrix, drill-down, drill-through, and cross-filtering.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Risk categories displayed as radar axes. Supports drill-down hierarchy (e.g. Portfolio > Program > Project).

dataRoles.name: series
dataRoles.description: Optional series grouping — each series draws a separate radar polygon (e.g. Project A, Project B).

dataRoles.name: value
dataRoles.description: Measure per category axis — e.g. Count of Risks, Sum of Exposure, Sum of CostImpact, or any DAX measure. Required.

dataRoles.name: maxValue
dataRoles.description: Maximum possible value per axis (optional). Defaults to auto-scale from data.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Target/threshold per axis (optional). Shown as dashed reference polygon.

dataRoles.name: previousValue
dataRoles.description: Previous period value (optional). Used for trend arrows in insights.

dataRoles.name: impact
dataRoles.description: Impact level for mini risk matrix (optional, 1–5 numeric).

dataRoles.name: likelihood
dataRoles.description: Likelihood level for mini risk matrix (optional, 1–5 numeric).

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Additional fields to show in tooltips.

dataRoles.name: drillthrough
dataRoles.description: Fields to pass when the user drills through to another page.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

showInsights.description: Toggle the insights sidebar on or off.

showSmartInsights.description: Render contextual callouts (concentration, hotspots, trend velocity, divergence) at the bottom of the panel.

showInfoButton.description: Show the (i) information button in the visual header.

infoText.description: Text shown in the info popover.

concentrationFactor.description: Multiplier vs. average that triggers a 'risk concentration' insight (default 2).

radarStyle.description: Shape of the radar grid lines.

showDataLabels.description: Display score values on data points.

showAnimation.description: Animate radar polygon on data load.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
